title: Bay Tree Egg, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description This is one of the most impressive Fabergé eggs — designed to resemble a bay tree in a jadeite planter, concealing a mechanical surprise within. In this contemporary interpretation, the jeweled masterpiece takes on a new form: a silver coin adorned with intricate patterns and exquisite embellishments. The composition of the tree crowned with foliage symbolizes victory and longevity, while the precise execution pays tribute to the timeless artistry of Fabergé.
